SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.reservation_no AS reservationNo, r.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, r.schedule_id AS scheduleId, s.schedule_no AS scheduleNo, s.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_type AS courseType, s.coach_id AS coachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, r.member_id AS memberId, m.real_name AS memberName, m.mobile AS memberMobile, r.card_id AS cardId, r.reservation_type AS reservationType, mc.card_name AS cardName, mc.plan_type AS planType, s.schedule_date AS scheduleDate,
s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, r.reservation_source AS reservationSource, r.reservation_status AS reservationStatus, r.reservation_time AS reservationTime, r.cancel_time AS cancelTime, r.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, r.consume_mode AS consumeMode, cr.checkin_id AS checkinId, cr.checkin_time AS checkinTime, cr.checkin_status AS checkinStatus, r.remark AS remark, r.create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: ORDER BY r.reservation_time DESC, r.reservation_id DESC
ORDER BY r.reservation_time DESC, r.reservation_id DESC

FROM fit_course_reservation r INNER JOIN fit_course_schedule s ON s.schedule_id = r.schedule_id AND s.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN fit_course c ON c.course_id = s.course_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = r.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = s.coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id = r.member_id AND m.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_member_card mc ON mc.card_id = r.card_id AND mc.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_checkin_record cr ON cr.reservation_id = r.reservation_id AND cr.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} LIMIT 1
